643-813-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-813-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3277-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
3277-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-4885-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

512-4091-7308.easyPrerequisites:
Mona Lisa and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
Mona Lisa has power 2 or greater.
512-4091-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Mona Lisa, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4091-7308.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Mona Lisa's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

62-833-907-3827.notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
62-833-907-3827.description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Selesnya Sanctuary from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Selesnya Sanctuary, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

301-2813-5961.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-2813-5961.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

240-719-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Xenograft, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-719-2438.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-5644-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Judith
1618-2440-5644-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Judith triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-5644-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Judith. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

489-1117-3689-6518.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4871-5147-5220-5447.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
4871-5147-5220-5447.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3532-4928-5078-7052.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-7052.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

804-7073.easyPrerequisites:
Pramikon and Sakashima the Impostor are naming different directions.
You have at least two opponents.
804-7073.description: Because Sakashima the Impostor and Pramikon disagree on the direction in which players can attack, players are unable to attack at all so long as there are three or more players.
804-7073.notes: Here is a relevant ruling from Pramikon relating to this lock: "If two Pramikons on the battlefield disagree on which direction three or more players must attack, players can't attack at all. (2019-08-23)"

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

4499-5361-7009.manaNeeded: {3} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
4499-5361-7009.description:
Activate Auton Soldier using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2421-2510-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

56-4976-5256-6248.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4976-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Open the Graves and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-4976-5256-6248.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

1479-2783-5033.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-2783-5033.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

1741-2617-4613-5917.notablePrerequisites:
Midnight Guard has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one mana-producing land.
1741-2617-4613-5917.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Midnight Guard using The Jolly Balloon Man's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cloud of Faeries that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Cloud of Faeries token enters the battlefield, it and Midnight Guard trigger.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries token's trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Resolve the Midnight Guard trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
1741-2617-4613-5917.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other creature using step 1 instead.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-3122--39.notablePrerequisites: Undercover Operative is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-3122--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Undercover Operative trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

6-1506-3341.notablePrerequisites:
Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness.
Burning Anger attached to Charnelhoard Wurm.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}.
6-1506-3341.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}.
Activate Charnelhoard Wurm by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to an opponent.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Vitalize to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Vitalize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2034-3458-4939-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary, adding {C}{C}.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Burning-Tree Emissary on top of your library from your graveyard.
Actviate Impromptu Raid by paying {2}{R/G}, revealing Burning-Tree Emissary from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Repeat.

1751-1817-2743.description:
Cast Storm King's Thunder by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Storm King's Thunder triggers, copying Double Major twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Double Majors, creating three copies of the Biovisionary spells.
Resolve all Biovisionary spells, causing you to have a nontoken Biovisionary and three token Biovisionaries.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1675-1751-4079.manaNeeded: {B}{R}{R}{R}, plus an additional {1} available for every twenty life your opponents collectively have
1675-1751-4079.description:
Cast Storm King's Thunder by paying {R}{R}{R} plus an additional {1} for every twenty life your opponents collectively have, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast that many times.
Cast Scheming Symmetry by paying {B}.
Storm King's Thunder triggers, copying Scheming Symmetry at least once.
Resolve a Scheming Symmetry, causing two opponents to search their library for a card, and then shuffle their libraries and put the card on top of it.
Ob Nixilis triggers for each opponent who searched their library, causing them to lose ten life.
Repeat from step 4 for each remaining Scheming Symmetry.

1617-2773-4186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Bellowing Aegisaur indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-2773-4186.description:
Give Bellowing Aegisaur indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Bellowing Aegisaur.
Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, dealing 1 damage to Bellowing Aegisaur.
Repeat from step 3.

2334-2493-4377.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
